data.name: Miskeenah
data.gender_notes: Miskeenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who is poor, needy, humble, and kind, seeking Allah's mercy and provision. The name Miskeenah carries the meaning “Poor, Needy, Humble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Miskeenah usually hope their child will grow to embody poor, needy, humble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A soul who is humbly seeking Allah's mercy and provision, striving for inner and outer purity.
data.etymology: Miskeenah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Poor, Needy, Humble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miskeenah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مِسكِينَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مِسكِينَة أسم عربي مشتق من الجذر مسك (مسك) ومعناه الحنيني، المرحوم، الحنون، الميسم، والله سبحانه وتعالى يرحم المساكين، ويحسن حظه، ويجعل حياتهم في الجنان رحا ومريحا، ويكونون محبوكين في جوار الله عز وجل
